newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 614 MW Homer City coal unit resumes operation.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 614 MW Homer City coal unit resumes operation.

text.p: The 614 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the coal-fired generating facility in Homer City, Pa., resumed operation late Friday, as expected, after being shut Thursday due to a turbine control problem, the operator said.
"It came back on line at 1146 p.m. (2346 EST) Friday," a spokesman for GPU Generation Inc saidt Monday.
Pennsylvania Electric Co (Penelec) and New York State Electric & Gas Corp each have a 50 percent interest in the Homer City unit.
Both Penelec and GPU Generation are subsidiaries of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
